title: Round activity
description: How much has traded in this round so far. Everything here resets when the next round opens.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: The dollar value of every fill this round. It only goes up until the round settles.

collateral.label: Open interest
collateral.description: Dollars locked behind positions still open in this round. Each open contract locks one dollar between its two sides.

trades.label: Trades
trades.description: How many fills have happened this round. A fill that crosses several orders counts once per order.

traders.label: Traders
traders.description: How many distinct accounts have traded this round, counting a user and their strategies as one.

largest_trade.label: Largest trade
largest_trade.description: The biggest single fill this round, in contracts. A jump here usually means a bot or a whale stepped in.
